data.title: Jobs & Work — Beginner · Lesson 2
data.subject: jobs
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Hey, it's your birthday, let's celebrate!)

[Hook]
Birthday party… La fiesta de cumpleaños
Balloons flying… Globos volando
Let's get to work… Vamos a trabajar
Smile and sing… Sonríe y canta
It's your day… Es tu día
No time to lose… No hay tiempo que perder

[Verse]
The driver… El chofer
Got the cake in the back.
The boss… El jefe
Said, "Take the day off, relax."
In the office… En la oficina
We were dreaming of this.
Now we're dancing… Ahora estamos bailando
Under the moonlit bliss.
The teacher… El maestro
Taught us how to groove.
Now we're singing… Ahora estamos cantando
Like there's nothing to prove.

[Hook]
Birthday party… La fiesta de cumpleaños
Balloons flying… Globos volando
Let's get to work… Vamos a trabajar
Smile and sing… Sonríe y canta
It's your day… Es tu día
No time to lose… No hay tiempo que perder

[Verse]
Good vibes… Buenas vibras
All around the room.
Laughter echoes… La risa resuena
Like a sweet melody's tune.
The job… El trabajo
